verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published tokens-per-second figures, latency benchmarks, or load-testing guides from DeepInfra. The docs only say qualitatively that the priority tier gives "faster time-to-first-token and higher throughput" and that the flex tier is slower, with no numbers. The one figure, a cold-start latency of "<10s", is an anecdotal community comment, not a published benchmark backing the provider's speed claims.
